title: Ford 5.4 3-valve: spark plug removal has its own factory procedure
summary: Ford issued dedicated spark plug removal instructions for the 5.4L 3-valve. Get the bulletin before pulling plugs.

specs.name: Remanufactured 2005-2008 5.4L/6.8L 3V engines
specs.value: Replace the original black spark plug boots with the longer brown boots supplied

body: NHTSA holds only the summary record of bulletin 06-15-2, not the document itself. The full removal procedure is available from Ford service information (Factory info tab). The earlier draft of this entry also covered cam phaser ticking. No published source for that has been found yet, so it was removed until one is cited.

sources.title: 06-15-2: Spark plug removal instructions - 5.4 3V
sources.citation: NHTSA manufacturer communication 10021048, date not recorded (summary record)

sources.title: SSM 46542: Remanufactured 5.4L/6.8L 3V engines: replace black spark plug boots with brown boots
